level_id_bank.verdict: NOT HELD. VERDICT: WATCH, constructive -- the cleanest base structure in this batch, but price is in the LOWER third of its box, not at an edge. Price 227.45 sits 1.39% above ladder A's fib-1 (224.33) which forms the floor of the operator's drawn olive box; that box is FIB-BOUNDED AT BOTH EDGES (floor 224.33 = A's anchor high, ceiling 246.94 = A's 1.115) with the 1D EMA200 (244.33) sitting 1.07% inside the ceiling. Beneath, a three-MA cluster (211.49/212.67/214.69) and a rising drawn rail (~205-212) form a tight backstop. 1D RSI 59.13 is well above its MA 44.85 and rising -- the momentum is with it. THE TRIGGER IS THE BOX CEILING: a daily close above 246.94 clears both the 1.115 rung and the EMA200 together and opens 265.75/277.80, then the 294-310 shelf. INVALIDATION: a daily close below 211.49 loses the MA cluster and the box floor together. The operator has drawn an explicit freehand path to ~355 -- recorded as their intent, not as levels, and note it requires the 246.94 ceiling to break first.
